title: Deep learning identifies skull fractures on cranial CT by detection and segmentation
summary: YOLOv3 object detection and a modified attention U-Net segmentation network were developed on CT scans of 4,782 patients with skull fractures (development n = 4,168, test n = 614) plus 7,856 healthy people. On an external test set of 235 patients (93 with fracture) the attention U-Net had sensitivity 82.80% and specificity 88.73% versus 80.64% and 85.92% for YOLOv3. Labels came from neurologists at one source, sensitivity is moderate and there are no outcome data.
